notes: Synthetic labels only; no credentials, private IDs, runtime URLs, or server payloads.

geometry.controlHeightHint: compact workstation control (~28–32px via density tokens)

expectedTokenGeometry: Disabled/loading regions show reduced opacity presentation only

r10.keyboardTouch: Enter and Space activate the button via user-event
r10.focus: Default button is focusable; disabled/loading are not activatable
r10.screenReader: loading exposes aria-busy; label text retained while loading
r10.reducedMotion: render under prefers-reduced-motion media where cheap; spinner presence is presentation
r10.validationBusyDisabledStatus: loading sets disabled + aria-busy; native disabled supported
r10.zoom: label remains readable at component level (no Playwright zoom matrix in U5)
r10.darkLight: render under data-theme zai-dark and zai-light wrappers
r10.narrow: inline-flex control does not require a dedicated narrow layout claim beyond shared viewport labels
